cohort_method: After public GO only: production panels.build, once per study, 80 people except R07 40. Freeze the generated files before browsing. No human outcomes or study titles in recruitment inputs.
assignment: Preserve returned order. Alternating members to a,b; first 40 unique people per arm. R07 all 40 get all eight cells; v=a when floor(index/8) is even, b otherwise. Never relax eligibility after seeing results.

studies.audience: Adults aged 18 or older in the United States, broadly distributed across ages, education levels and incomes, participating in a paid consumer survey about online privacy. Approximately 47 percent men. Age proportions: 18-24 11 percent, 25-34 18 percent, 35-44 18 percent, 45-54 17 percent, 55-64 19 percent, 65+ 17 percent.
studies.goal: You are finishing a paid consumer questionnaire with Harbor Research. Continue through its final pages as you naturally would.
studies.context: You have already answered demographic and privacy questions. A partner offer appears at the end. Whether to keep it is entirely your decision. Completing the questionnaire does not require accepting the offer.
studies.hard_eligibility: US residence; adult; no instruction to purchase or to reject

studies.audience: German-speaking undergraduate students in technical subjects (computer science, engineering, mathematics, physics) at universities in Austria or Germany, mostly in their first year, taking part in a classroom study of flight-search user experience. Approximately 60 percent attend university in Austria and 40 percent in Germany; this is a preference, not a hard rule.
studies.goal: Suchen Sie auf Weitflug nach einer Verbindung von Wien nach Hamburg am 20. November 2026.
studies.context: Sie nehmen an einer Untersuchung zur Bedienung von Flugsuchseiten teil. Nutzen Sie die Seite selbstständig.
studies.hard_eligibility: Austria or Germany; German-speaking undergraduate in a technical subject; adult

studies.audience: United Kingdom residents aged 18 to 65, recruited from an online research panel to review news websites. Target mean age about 35; approximately 69 percent women, 31 percent men. They have varied everyday privacy habits.
studies.goal: Browse the eight news websites in this review task. On each, choose your settings as you naturally would and give a quick impression before continuing.
studies.context: This is a study of news-site design. Work through the portfolio independently.
